name: mei-07
situation: Definition, wrong restatement, agent reference (same moves as mei-04, ablated baseline)
reading_goal: Get a general overview of this paper
moves: Ask in a broad way what this article is about.
Ask how the author defines a game mechanic.
Restate it wrongly in your own words: a game mechanic is just a rule of the game.
Say you still do not get it and ask for another explanation.
Refer to 'the agent' with a short reference and ask who that is.
Ask whether jumping in a platform game counts as a mechanic under this definition.
